lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice comparing two everyday options with common comparatives.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing between two housing or transport options based on cost, time, and convenience.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Comparing alternatives before making a practical decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare two ways to get somewhere or two possible apartments and discuss which is more practical.

main_focus.name: comparatives for everyday choices
main_focus.description: Use comparative forms such as billigare, snabbare, större, mindre, and lättare to compare two options.
model_examples: Den andra lägenheten är större men längre bort.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use comparative forms naturally 5-6 times in the dialogue.

useful_chunks: Å andra sidan är den dyrare.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday comparison words with practical decision language.

dialogue_shape.middle: They compare cost, time, distance, or convenience and mention one drawback.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the more practical option or decide what detail to check next.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat comparatives across several practical criteria

focus: which two options are being compared
the most important difference between the options
which option seems more practical and why

sentence_focus: one comparative sentence with billigare än
one comparative sentence with snabbare or långsammare
one sentence comparing distance with närmare or längre bort
one sentence with a drawback after men
one question asking which option fits best
